features.text: First release of the OpenGL Shading Language; replaces the GL 1.1 fixed-function vertex/fragment program model.
Two stages only: vertex and fragment.
Qualifiers const, uniform, attribute, varying; types float, vec2-4, mat2-4, bool, sampler2D.
Built-ins gl_Position, gl_FragColor, gl_FragCoord, gl_PointSize, gl_Normal, gl_Color, gl_TexCoord.
No #version directive is required; a shader without one is treated as targeting version 1.10.
No integer types and no geometry, tessellation, compute, image or buffer types.
Integer scalar and vector types (int, uint, ivec2-4, uvec2-4) and integer uniforms.
Non-square matrix types (mat2x3, mat3x2, mat2x4, mat4x2, ...).
Array constructors, for example float[3](1.0, 2.0, 3.0).
Stage set unchanged: vertex and fragment only.
The #version directive becomes mandatory and the declared version must match the language in use.
Bitwise operators on integers (& | ^ ~ << >>), ++/--, compound assignment, switch and do-while statements.
Explicit-LOD and texel-fetch texture functions (textureLod, texelFetch).
gl_FragDepth and gl_FrontFacing built-ins.
Multiple render targets through gl_FragData[].
Integer texture formats and their sampler types (isampler*/usampler*, ARB_texture_integer).
Precision qualifiers lowp, mediump, highp.
Stage set unchanged: vertex and fragment only.
Geometry shader stage introduced (ARB_geometry_shader4, OpenGL 3.1).
Uniform blocks with an explicit std140 layout.
textureGather family and the textureOffset variants.
samplerBuffer, for texture buffer objects (ARB_texture_buffer_object, OpenGL 3.1).

First version that carries a profile argument: '#version 150 core' or '#version 150 compatibility'. A profile argument can only be used with version 150 or greater, and if no profile is given the default is core.
'in'/'out' replace 'attribute'/'varying'; the latter are deprecated but remain available in the compatibility profile.
layout qualifiers, including layout(location=) for fragment outputs.
Separate sampler objects are distinguished from combined sampler/image uniform slots.
gl_FragColor and gl_FragData exist only in the compatibility profile.
Tessellation shaders are NOT part of this version; they arrive with GLSL 4.00.
Version 330: the language version required by the OpenGL 3.3 core profile.
'in'/'out' everywhere; 'attribute'/'varying' are no longer part of the core language.
layout(location=) extended to vertex inputs and outputs (ARB_enhanced_layouts).
gl_VertexID and gl_InstanceID built-ins.
Stage set unchanged from 1.50: vertex, fragment and geometry. Tessellation shaders arrive with GLSL 4.00.
Tessellation control and tessellation evaluation shader stages introduced (ARB_tessellation_shader, OpenGL 4.0).
64-bit integer types int64_t and uint64_t (ARB_gpu_shader_int64).
Double-precision floating point: double, dvec2-4, dmat2-4 (ARB_gpu_shader_fp64).
Texture LOD query functions (textureQueryLod, textureQueryLevels).
Transform feedback 3.0: multiple streams and interleaved queries.
gl_ViewportIndex built-in (ARB_viewport_array).
Separate sampler objects: 'sampler' is a distinct opaque type from the texture sampler types.
No new shader stage.
Image types (image1D..imageBuffer, iimage*, uimage*) with imageLoad/imageStore/imageAtomic* (ARB_shader_image_load_store).
Atomic counters (atomic_uint) with atomicCounterIncrement, atomicCounterDecrement and friends (ARB_shader_atomic_counters).
Memory qualifiers coherent, volatile, restrict, readonly, writeonly on image and buffer variables.
No new shader stage.
Compute shader stage introduced (OpenGL 4.3) with local_size_x/y/z, shared variables, memoryBarrier and group-shared storage.
Shader storage buffer objects (layout(std430) buffer variables).
Subroutines: the 'subroutine' keyword, subroutine types and subroutine uniforms.
Program interface queries: named uniforms and uniform blocks with resource locations.
Image load/store extended to the vertex, tessellation and geometry stages.
Extended layout qualifier set on uniforms and blocks (binding, offset, align, ...).
Dynamic indexing of arrays of samplers and of uniform arrays.
ARB_gpu_shader5 arithmetic and layout extensions.
No new shader stage.
Cull distance built-ins (gl_CullDistance, ARB_clip_cull_distance).

The 4.50 revision does not yet contain ARB_shader_atomic_counter_ops, ARB_shader_draw_parameters, ARB_shader_group_vote or ARB_gl_spirv: the 4.60 revision summary lists all four as newly incorporated.
No new shader stage.

features.reference: GLSL 4.60 spec, sec. 3.3, PDF p.17 and p.19
features.text: '#version 460' is required in any shader that uses version 4.60 of the language, and __VERSION__ substitutes the decimal integer 460.
Incorporates GL_ARB_shader_atomic_counter_ops, GL_ARB_shader_draw_parameters, GL_ARB_shader_group_vote and GL_ARB_gl_spirv.
Six stages: vertex, tessellation control, tessellation evaluation, geometry, fragment and compute.

The compatibility profile adds the fixed-function fragment outputs gl_FragColor and gl_FragData and the fixed-function vertex inputs gl_Color, gl_SecondaryColor, gl_Normal, gl_Vertex and gl_MultiTexCoord0-7.
When compiling for OpenGL SPIR-V the macro GL_SPIRV is predefined as 100.
Compatibility-profile features are not available when generating SPIR-V.

profiles.core: OpenGL core profile (profile='core' or no profile attribute)
profiles.legacy: GL 1.0 - 3.1: no profile attribute in the registry

semantics.compat_not_core_definition: present in the compatibility profile but absent from the core profile (includes the fixed-function entry points dropped from core in GL 3.2)
semantics.compat_only_definition: required by a `profile="compatibility"` require block and never a core entry point (this is the definition used by tools/gl46_catalog.py and by the self-check)
semantics.profile_model_legacy_versions: GL 1.0 - 3.1 carry no profile attribute in gl.xml and are modelled as a single unsplit surface (core == compatibility)
semantics.remove_no_profile: removed everywhere from that version onward
semantics.remove_profile_compatibility: removed from the compatibility profile only
semantics.remove_profile_core: removed from the core profile only
semantics.within_feature_order: remove blocks applied before require blocks
